svg.title: Proposed ADBC lockup horizontal construction grid
svg.text: Proposed ADBC lockup · horizontal construction grid
The dimetric logomark with the name set like the Apache Arrow wordmark. Every size and position comes from the logomark’s grid.
ADBC caps, from the first wall’s bottom
The logomark’s cells, 10 wide × 7.5 tall (mark = 100 wide). Rows count down from the mark’s top corner.
APACHE ARROW in Roboto Regular, caps 2 cells; ADBC in Barlow Bold, caps 6 cells. That is 3 : 1,
as ARROW is to APACHE in the Apache Arrow wordmark. Both in capitals, normal kerning, no tracking.
APACHE ARROW sits on the top of the first layer’s side wall (row 5). One cell below it, ADBC runs
from that wall’s bottom (row 6) to the bottom of the last layer’s side wall (row 12).
ADBC’s midline (row 9) is the mark’s (rows 1–17), as ARROW is centred on the Arrow chevrons.
At 3 : 1 both lines come out 157.3–157.6 wide, within 0.2%, so the name is flush left and right.
2 cells between the mark and the name. The canvas is cropped to the ink: rows 1–17.
